releases.notes:
added my own wardrobe swap, relying on taunahi's one is very inconsistent, this is also much quicker than taunahis one
run /pest wardrobe , it will ask you what slots your armor sets are on

added /pest guidelay ms (default is 400, no arg shows current value)
only change if your on high ping or it isnt swapping to all pieces

added subcommand /pest extrasell 1-10 (threshold)
added subcommand /pest georgesell 1-10 (threshold)
added command /pest dropbooks 1-10 (only really useful for ironman)
this will only drop pesterminator 1 and sunder 6 books
this will trigger after pest cleaner finished, if flying it will hold space for 2 seconds, if not it will first double tap space for flight (to prevent picking them back up)
added /pest status shows all your settings
removed /pest toggle all as /pest toggle alone will now toggle all

hopefully fixed a few bugs
visitors breaking when inventory is full (not tested)
visitors false flagging teleport back after finishes. (not tested)
not equipping blossom/lotus cloak outside of jacob (already in 2.0.21)
fixed shutdown safety not detecting if youre already back in skyblock causing it to keep running /skyblock (should work, slighty tested)
cleaned code up a bit
updated /pest help to match with current commands
added a schematic to the readme file
changed the setup a bit so its slightly easier and has more options
